Anthem of the Sun.bio: Anthem of the Sun is a Ventura Grateful Dead tribute band, formerly known as Peoples Dead. They host Ventura Dead Night on Thursdays at 7pm at Winchester's Grill & Saloon downtown.
Anthem of the Sun.bio_source: Written by TOPA from @anthemofthesun.band and venturagratefuldead.com.

Brandon Ragan Project.bio: The Brandon Ragan Project is a funk and blues band from Ventura. Brandon Ragan is a saxophonist from Alabama with a background in gospel jazz who now calls Downtown Ventura home. The band plays regularly at Tony's Pizzaria in Ventura.
Brandon Ragan Project.bio_source: Written by TOPA from brandonragan.com and @thebrandonraganproject5000.

The Brandon Ragan Project.bio: The Brandon Ragan Project is a funk and blues band from Ventura. Brandon Ragan is a saxophonist from Alabama with a background in gospel jazz who now calls Downtown Ventura home. The band plays regularly at Tony's Pizzaria in Ventura.
The Brandon Ragan Project.bio_source: Written by TOPA from brandonragan.com and @thebrandonraganproject5000.

Cinnamon Whiskey.bio: Cinnamon Whiskey is a Ventura County cover band playing hits from the 1960s to today, at venues around the county like Winchesters Grill and Harbor Cove Cafe.
Cinnamon Whiskey.bio_source: Written by TOPA from their website and @cinnamonwhiskeyband.

Crosscut 805.bio: Crosscut is a Ventura County band that has been playing since 1992. They describe themselves as a "Big Mix" dance band playing a wide variety of songs.
Crosscut 805.bio_source: Written by TOPA from @crosscutband805 and their Facebook page.

Danny D.bio: Danny D sings the Frank Sinatra songbook on Tuesday evenings at Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar in Ventura.
Danny D.bio_source: Written by TOPA from local show listings.

Duane Bartels Trio.bio: Duane Bartels is an 805 guitarist, singer and songwriter who also hosts open mics. He plays around Ojai, including the Ojai Vineyard and the Ranch House.

Duane Bartels.bio: Duane Bartels is an 805 guitarist, singer and songwriter who also hosts open mics. He plays around Ojai, including the Ojai Vineyard and the Ranch House.

Frank Barajas.bio: Frank Barajas is a Ventura-born guitarist, singer and songwriter. He first made his name with the power-pop band Durango 95 and has recorded four studio albums, most recently The Third Man in 2015. Today he plays solo, in duos and with bands around Ventura County.
Frank Barajas.bio_source: Written by TOPA from Frank's Facebook and the Ojai Valley News.

Frank Barajas and Joe Hamiliton.bio: Frank Barajas is a Ventura-born guitarist, singer and songwriter. He first made his name with the power-pop band Durango 95 and has recorded four studio albums, most recently The Third Man in 2015. Today he plays solo, in duos and with bands around Ventura County.
Frank Barajas and Joe Hamiliton.bio_source: Written by TOPA from Frank's Facebook and the Ojai Valley News.

Frank Barajas & Joe Hamilton.bio_source: Written by TOPA from Frank's Facebook and the Ojai Valley News.

Fred Kaplan Trio.bio: Fred Kaplan is a blues pianist whose career goes back to the early 1970s, when he helped form the Hollywood Fats Band. He records and tours as a solo pianist and as a sideman and producer for blues artists, and his trio plays Friday evenings at The Grape in Ventura.
Fred Kaplan Trio.bio_source: Written by TOPA from fredkaplanmusic.com and @fredkaplanmusic.

Happy hour w/ Fred Kaplan Trio.bio: Fred Kaplan is a blues pianist whose career goes back to the early 1970s, when he helped form the Hollywood Fats Band. He records and tours as a solo pianist and as a sideman and producer for blues artists, and his trio plays Friday evenings at The Grape in Ventura.
Happy hour w/ Fred Kaplan Trio.bio_source: Written by TOPA from fredkaplanmusic.com and @fredkaplanmusic.

Jared Nels.bio: Jared Nels is a Santa Barbara singer-songwriter, guitarist and yodeler who grew up in Des Moines, Iowa, where he won the Iowa State Fair yodeling contest several times. He performs across Southern and Central California and is working on his first album.
Jared Nels.bio_source: Written by TOPA from @yodelnels and his artist bio.

Jerry Breiner.bio: Jerry Breiner is a Ventura County multi-instrumentalist and singer-songwriter. He also plays in the Big Adventure Band, which plays covers from across the decades.
Jerry Breiner.bio_source: Written by TOPA from @jbreiner and Winchester's Grill.

Jim Friery.bio: Jim Friery is a Ventura County singer-songwriter who has lived here since 1978. His sets mix country, folk and classic rock with his own songs, which draw on his life, the places he loves and the people he meets. He plays solo around the county and also plays bluegrass, including Thursdays with the Boatyard Bluegrass Jam Band in Ventura.

Josephoenix.bio: Josephoenix takes songs you already know by heart and turns them inside out, with funk grooves, jazz-style solos and a lot of soul. A big voice out front and a rhythm section and keys that like to stretch out mean a familiar chorus can turn into something new halfway through. Bring dancing shoes: they describe themselves as a bottomless barrel of grooves with a twist.
Josephoenix.bio_source: Written by TOPA from josephoenix.com and @josephoenixband.

Katie Shorey.bio: Katie Shorey is a Los Angeles singer and an award-winning Stevie Nicks tribute artist.

Ken Devoe.bio: Ken DeVoe plays acoustic music around Ventura County, with a regular Tuesday evening spot at the Boatyard Pub in Ventura.
Ken Devoe.bio_source: Written by TOPA from Ken's Facebook and local show listings.

Muzical Chairz.bio: Muzical Chairz is a cover band playing multi-genre hits. They play venues around Thousand Oaks like Tarantula Hill Brewing and Crown and Anchor, and they also play private parties and weddings.
Muzical Chairz.bio_source: Written by TOPA from the Muzical Chairz Facebook page.

Natalie Wattre.bio: Natalie Wattre is a Southern California singer-songwriter who performs with her guitar, and Music Connection magazine has praised her vocal range. Her covers run from Aretha Franklin, Marvin Gaye and Prince to Fleetwood Mac, Queen, Adele and Bruno Mars, and she also plays her own songs, including "After the Drought" and "Follow Through."
Natalie Wattre.bio_source: Written by TOPA from nataliewattre.com and @nataliewattre.

Neon Blonde.bio: Neon Blonde is a Ventura and Santa Barbara cover band playing post-punk and new wave, with songs by artists like Talking Heads, Elvis Costello, The Cure, Devo, Depeche Mode and David Bowie.
Neon Blonde.bio_source: Written by TOPA from neonblonde.band and @neonblonde.band.

Strummed Down.bio: Strummed Down is an acoustic duo playing covers from across the decades, with shows around Simi Valley and Camarillo.

TD Lind & the Aviators.bio: TD Lind & the Aviators are an indie rock band from Ojai, formed in 2022. TD Lind, who was born in England, toured the U.S. and Europe for about 30 years and made four albums before starting the band. They released the live album Into the Light in 2023 and the studio album Golden in 2024, and their newest album is The Copper Room.
TD Lind & the Aviators.bio_source: Written by TOPA from undergroundsun.com, The Grape and @tdlindandtheaviators.

TD Lind and the Aviators.bio: TD Lind & the Aviators are an indie rock band from Ojai, formed in 2022. TD Lind, who was born in England, toured the U.S. and Europe for about 30 years and made four albums before starting the band. They released the live album Into the Light in 2023 and the studio album Golden in 2024, and their newest album is The Copper Room.
TD Lind and the Aviators.bio_source: Written by TOPA from undergroundsun.com, The Grape and @tdlindandtheaviators.

Teresa Russell.bio: Teresa Russell is a Southern California blues-rock guitarist and singer. She started out playing the Sunset Strip at a young age and has shared stages with Johnny Winter, Walter Trout and Kenny Wayne Shepherd. She was also the only woman in the top eight at the national Guitarmageddon finals.
Teresa Russell.bio_source: Written by TOPA from teresarussell.com, the Santa Maria Sun and @teresarussellguitar.

The Sea Hunters.bio: The Sea Hunters are a Ventura surf, rock and pop band playing covers and their own songs. They play happy hour on Tuesdays at Vaquero y Mar in Ventura.

Vinny Berry.bio: Vinny Berry is a rock and roll and blues singer who grew up in Los Angeles and now lives on the coast near Ventura. He plays his own songs alongside covers of artists from Otis Redding and the Beatles to Tom Petty, Chris Stapleton, Pearl Jam and Amy Winehouse. He also released the album Seeker and the Sound with his band, the Vinny Berry Connection.
Vinny Berry.bio_source: Written by TOPA from vinnyberrymusic.com and @vinnyberrymusic.

Vinyl Gypsies.bio: The Vinyl Gypsies are a Southern California classic rock band playing well-known hits with their own twist. Along with their full electric show, they also play acoustic sets.
Vinyl Gypsies.bio_source: Written by TOPA from vinylgypsies.com and @vinyl_gypsies.

Boatyard Pub.bio: The Boatyard Pub is a seafood pub and restaurant at Ventura Harbor, with local craft beers on tap and a patio overlooking the harbor. It hosts live music most days of the week.
Boatyard Pub.bio_source: Written by TOPA from boatyardpub.com and @boatyardpub.

Harbor Cove Cafe.bio: Harbor Cove Cafe is an island-themed, dog-friendly cafe on Spinnaker Drive at Ventura Harbor, serving breakfast, lunch, dinner and tropical drinks. It has been open under its current name since 2005 and hosts live music.
Harbor Cove Cafe.bio_source: Written by TOPA from harborcovecafe.net, @harborcovecafe and the cafe's Facebook.

C Note Bar & Lounge.bio: C Note Bar & Lounge, formerly the Keynote Lounge, is a bar on Telephone Road in East Ventura with patio seating and TVs. It hosts karaoke on Sunday nights.
C Note Bar & Lounge.bio_source: Written by TOPA from the C Note Bar & Lounge Facebook and @keynotelounge.

KJ's Neighborhood Bar.bio: KJ's Neighborhood Bar is a bar on East Main Street in downtown Ventura with live music, karaoke, DJs and special events. It hosts karaoke on Wednesday and Friday nights.
KJ's Neighborhood Bar.bio_source: Written by TOPA from @kjs_neighborhoodbar, its Facebook and @venturakaraoke.

Lucky Fools Pub.bio: Lucky Fools Pub is a pub on High Street in Old Town Moorpark that hosts live music.
Lucky Fools Pub.bio_source: Written by TOPA from the Lucky Fools Pub Facebook.

Nectar of the Dogs Wine.bio: Nectar of the Dogs Wine is a dog-friendly tasting room on Chambers Lane in Simi Valley, pouring its own California wines. It hosts a musicians' jam night on Thursdays and live music Friday and Saturday evenings, including Country Music Fridays.

Ric's Restaurant Sports Lounge.bio_source: Written by TOPA from @ricscamarillo and Visit Camarillo.

Rock & Roll Pizza (Harley's Valley Bowl.bio: Rock & Roll Pizza Bar is the pizza bar and live entertainment room inside harley's Valley Bowl on Cochran Street in Simi Valley, serving New York-style pizza, craft beer and cocktails. It hosts local bands each week, along with comedy, karaoke and line dancing.
Rock & Roll Pizza (Harley's Valley Bowl.bio_source: Written by TOPA from harleysbowl.com and @rocknrollpizzabar.

Sagebrush Cantina Restaurant & Saloon.bio: Sagebrush Cantina is a Mexican-American restaurant and saloon in Old Town Calabasas, open since 1974. It hosts live bands, solo acoustic performers, DJs and karaoke nights, with mariachi music at Sunday brunch.
Sagebrush Cantina Restaurant & Saloon.bio_source: Written by TOPA from sagebrushcantina.com and the Sagebrush Cantina Facebook.

Sam's Place (The Vine).bio: Sam's Place is a bar and kitchen with a small stage on East Ojai Avenue in downtown Ojai, hosting local live music.
Sam's Place (The Vine).bio_source: Written by TOPA from samsplaceojai.com and @samsplaceojai.

Taqueria Jalisco Restaurant.bio: Taqueria Jalisco Mexican Grill is a family-run Mexican restaurant on Tierra Rejada Road in Moorpark, serving since 1998. It hosts acoustic music on Fridays.

The Deer Lodge.bio: The Deer Lodge is a historic restaurant and tavern on Maricopa Highway in Ojai, serving smokehouse barbecue and pub food. It hosts an open mic every Wednesday and live music on weekends.
The Deer Lodge.bio_source: Written by TOPA from deerlodgeojai.com and @ojaideerlodge.

The Garage.bio: The Garage is a neighborhood cocktail bar on Scandia Avenue in East Ventura that hosts live music.
The Garage.bio_source: Written by TOPA from thegaragebarvta.com and @thegaragebarventura.

The Grape.bio: The Grape is a 21-and-over jazz club and cocktail bar on East Main Street in midtown Ventura. It grew out of Squashed Grapes, a wine bar that started hosting live jazz in 2010, and moved to its current home in 2021. It hosts jazz and blues Tuesday through Saturday, including the Gratitude Jazz Jam on Tuesdays and blues on Saturday afternoons.
The Grape.bio_source: Written by TOPA from thegrapeventura.com and The Grape's Facebook.

The Hive Bar and Lounge.address: 2780 Tapo Canyon Rd, Simi Valley, CA 93063

The Manhattan of Camarillo.bio: The Manhattan of Camarillo is an Italian restaurant on Santa Rosa Road with live music, an attached beer garden and a private wine room.
The Manhattan of Camarillo.bio_source: Written by TOPA from The Manhattan's Facebook, @manhattancamarillo and Visit Camarillo.

The Original Pizza Cookery.address: 75 W Thousand Oaks Blvd, Thousand Oaks, CA 91360

The Shores.bio: The Shores is a neighborhood bar and restaurant in Oxnard Shores, a few blocks from the beach on Harbor Boulevard. It hosts local bands, acoustic sets and DJs, plus karaoke on Thursday nights.
The Shores.bio_source: Written by TOPA from theshoresoxnard.com and @theshoresoxnard.

Thousand Oaks Performing Arts Center.address: 2100 E Thousand Oaks Blvd, Thousand Oaks, CA 91362

Tony's Pizzaria.bio: Tony's Pizzaria is a family-run pizzeria on East Thompson Boulevard near Surfers Point in Ventura, open since 1959. It has an eat-in patio, outdoor games and a fire pit.
Tony's Pizzaria.bio_source: Written by TOPA from tonyspizzaria.net and @tonys_pizzaria.

Ventura Music Hall - VMH.bio: Ventura Music Hall is a concert venue on East Thompson Boulevard in midtown Ventura. Since opening in 2022 it has hosted touring and local acts in rock, reggae, country, metal and more, along with comedy and family shows. Most shows are all ages.
Ventura Music Hall - VMH.bio_source: Written by TOPA from venturamusichall.com, @venturamusichall and Visit Ventura.

Winchesters Grill & Saloon.bio: Winchesters Grill & Saloon is a steakhouse and saloon on East Main Street in downtown Ventura, open since 1997, with around 40 beers on tap and a large patio. It hosts live music Thursday through Sunday.
Winchesters Grill & Saloon.bio_source: Written by TOPA from @winchestersgrill, its Facebook and Visit Ventura.
